```{python}
import polars as pl
import numpy as np
from lets_plot import *
from polars import col

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)
```

```{python}
# Learn morea about Code Cells: https://quarto.org/docs/reference/cells/cells-jupyter.html

df = pl.read_csv("https://posit.byui.edu/content/0d43d66f-d3b7-4c43-8c36-52e3ed69e7f1/names_year_csv.csv")
```

```{python}
elliot_df = df.filter(name="Elliot")

(
ggplot(elliot_df, aes("year", "Total"))
+ geom_line(aes(color="name"))
+ scale_color_manual(values={"Elliot": "blue"})
+ scale_x_continuous(format=".0f")
+ scale_y_continuous(format=".0f")
+ ggsize(800, 400)
+ coord_cartesian([1950, 2025])
+ labs("Elliot...What?", x="year", y="")
+ theme_gray()
+ theme(
    legend_position="right",
    legend_justification=[1, 1],
    plot_title=element_text(hjust=-0.05, family="serif", size=25),
    panel_grid_minor=element_blank(),
    axis_ticks=element_blank(),
    axis_text=element_text(family="serif", size=18),
    axis_title=element_text(family="serif", size=25)
    )
+ geom_vline(xintercept=1982, linetype="dashed", color="red", size=1.1)
+ geom_text(x=1975, y=3000, label="E.T. Released", size=9)
+ geom_vline(xintercept=1984, linetype="dashed", color="red", size=1.1)
+ geom_text(x=1992, y=3000, label="Second Release", size=9)
+ geom_vline(xintercept=2002, linetype="dashed", color="red", size=1.1)
+ geom_text(x=2009, y=3000, label="Third Release", size=9)
)
```
